lines.text: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan, the LORD tells Moses to command Israel to give the Levites cities and pasturelands.
Three cities of refuge are across the Jordan and three are in Moab, for someone who kills unintentionally.

wrong_details.true: three are in the land of Canaan

lines.text: No one is executed on one witness's testimony, and the LORD says no ransom may be accepted for a murderer.
